translations.web: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.
translations.bsb: The day after the Passover, on that very day, they ate unleavened bread and roasted grain from the produce of the land.
translations.kjv: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
translations.asv: And they did eat of the produce of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes and parched grain, in the selfsame day.
